CustomField.description: Total Expected to Date. Sum of Expected Total Commitment Amount (ExpectedTotalCmtAmount) across every Gift Commitment linked to this Opportunity by the standard Opportunity relationship. Maintained by the DLRS roll-up Grant Total Expected to Date (dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2) - it cannot be a native roll-up summary because Gift Commitment is joined to Opportunity by lookup, not master-detail. Do not edit by hand; DLRS overwrites it on the next Gift Commitment change.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total reimbursement expected to date, summed from Expected Total Commitment Amount on this grant's Gift Commitments. Calculated - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Total Expected to Date
